🇲🇽🏗️ <u>CDMX PUBLIC INVESTMENT UP 2.6X IN FIRST HALF OF 2026</u>

Mexico City spent 17.66 billion pesos on public investment in the first half of 2026 — 2.6 times the same period last year, finance secretary Juan Pablo de Botton reported. Public works jumped 88.4%, water spending rose 28% to 7.1 billion pesos, and welfare grew 23%. All while the city's public debt has fallen 8.4% since 2018. Investing more while owing less: republican austerity in practice.

🇲🇽📱 <u>SHEINBAUM SEEKS NATIONAL CONSENSUS TO SHIELD KIDS FROM SOCIAL MEDIA</u>

President Sheinbaum said Mexico could simply ban cellphones in schools — but she wants a national consensus instead, bringing in parents, teachers and the kids themselves, and warned that unchecked screen time is turning into a public health problem. Specialists at the mañanera showed how platform-driven dopamine overload hits the prefrontal cortex of minors. Sixteen states have already restricted phones in classrooms. Regulate Big Tech with science and consensus, not decree.
banner: SHEINBAUM: PROTECT KIDS FROM SOCIAL MEDIA

🇲🇽🏫 <u>MEXICO'S SEP: MILITARIZED SCHOOLS ARE NOT PERMITTED, PERIOD</u>

After the death of 13-year-old Dafne at a "militarized academy" summer camp in Tamaulipas, Education Secretary Mario Delgado ordered every state government to audit schools selling military-style basic education. "It's not that they're prohibited — it's that they're not permitted. Neither the SEP nor the Defense Ministry authorizes this type of education," he said. Tamaulipas already found five more such schools; their permits are now under review. Childhood is not boot camp. The 4T is drawing the line.

🇲🇽🛢️ 84% of gas stations now sell diesel under 27 pesos. "Over 8,600 stations are complying with the voluntary price agreement." — Iván Escalante, Profeco chief National average: 27.05 pesos/liter. A public map, updated daily, names the stations breaking the deal. The basic basket also held: cheapest at 736.50 in Reynosa, all monitored stores under the 910-peso cap.

🇲🇽🚴 Isaac del Toro: first Mexican ever on a Tour de France podium. "I don't think these kids spent their days on the phone." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on Mexico's athletes Del Toro finished 3rd overall at the 2026 Tour and won stage 2. Mexico also leads the Central American and Caribbean Games medal table in Santo Domingo: 43 medals, 16 gold.
banner: DEL TORO: FIRST MEXICAN ON TOUR PODIUM

text: 🧠🇲🇽 "Twenty years ago we could spend 2.5 minutes on a screen task; now it's 47 seconds before we get distracted." "The adolescent brain: a powerful accelerator at 15, brakes still developing until 25." — Dr. Lucía Magis Weinberg, University of Washington More screen time in adolescence is linked to thinning in brain regions and eroded attention. Cellphone access before age 12 is associated with cognitive development issues.

📱🇲🇽 New generations will lose 20 years of their lives to social media. "It's not just that a child becomes apathetic — their brain may already be functioning differently." — Tania Jiménez, addiction prevention specialist Under dopamine overstimulation the brain stops producing it and hides receptors, specialists explained at the mañanera. Recovery is possible: neuroplasticity.
banner: GEN Z: 20 YEARS LOST TO SOCIAL MEDIA

text: 📱🇲🇽 "Algorithms obey the market — that's how they're designed." "There are interests auctioning our attention in real time. That's why inflated controversies thrive, divisive debate is rewarded, and intolerance grows." — Mario Delgado, Secretary of Public Education Mexico opened a national discussion on screens, social media, and children. France just regulated social media access for under-15s; each country will reach its own definition.
